items.prompt:
Constructive processes
A) build up Earth's features
B) wear down features
C) do nothing
D) only make weather

Destructive processes
A) wear down Earth's features
B) build features up
C) create new planets
D) stop time

A volcano building a mountain is
A) constructive
B) destructive
C) neither
D) weather

A canyon forming over millions of years is a
A) slow, destructive process
B) fast, constructive process
C) fast, destructive process
D) instant event

A volcanic eruption forming new land is a
A) fast, constructive process
B) slow, destructive process
C) slow, constructive process
D) fast, destructive process

Weathering and erosion are examples of ____ processes.
A) destructive
B) constructive
C) nuclear
D) chemical only

steps: Weathering and erosion wear features down.

items.prompt:
A mountain's shape over time results from
A) building-up and wearing-down processes acting together
B) only building up
C) only wearing down
D) no processes
items.answer: A) building-up and wearing-down processes acting together

steps: Both process types shape the mountain.

items.prompt:
Which best models how a landscape changes over time?
A) Internal processes build mountains up while surface processes wear them down
B) Nothing ever changes
C) Only the weather changes
D) Mountains appear instantly and stay forever
items.answer: A) Internal processes build mountains up while surface processes wear them down

steps: Both processes change the landscape over time.
